Title: Nod, how is the rearraging of equipment done.

Messages.Author: Whisker
Messages.Body:
Ok, quick question. How is the rearrangement of equiment from Nod handled? Do you choose new end state (e.g. what equipment end to which minion) or can you do this incrementally (e.g. first minion 1 gets all stuff and then minion 2 & 3 get this specific piece of equipment)?

This is mainly relevant for Martinelli's ring e.g. can I cycle it though all my minions removing nasty dem / ser cards on them?

Nod
Master
Master: trifle.
Beginning with you and going clockwise once around the table, each Methuselah can rearrange the equipment on his or her ready minions.

A smart Lick could move merchandise, people, drugs or just about anything else using the club as cover.
Artist(s): Joel Biske

Martinelli's Ring
Equipment
Unique equipment.
Cards that require Malkavian, Malkavian antitribu, Dementation [dem] or Serpentis [ser] cannot target or be placed on this minion. Burn any cards on this minion that require any of those clans or Disciplines.
Artist(s): Eric Lofgren

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
You choose for each equipment which minion will receive it, then transfer all the equipment accordingly.
You cannot choose to move an equipment from A to B then C.

Prince of Paris, France
